_about: Platform achievements (ADR-0018), in the order the platforms show them. The core does not read this file. Each achievement: id, name and description (the text that the platform shows), milestone (a milestone id of the core, see src/core/milestones.gd: first_sale, first_mixed_factory, factories, first_automatic_transport, first_warehouse, first_split, first_community_investment, first_research, prisms_bought, prestiges, or factory.<color>, transport_tier.<tier> (not the first tier), research.<research>, prestige_upgrade.<upgrade>), at_least (optional, default 1: the value of the milestone that grants it; above 1 only for the counts factories, prisms_bought, and prestiges), and platform_ids (optional): the id of the achievement on steam (the API name in Steamworks), game_center (the achievement ID in App Store Connect), and google_play (the ID that the Play Console gives). An empty or missing id means that platform does not have the achievement yet. PLACEHOLDER achievements, names, and ids until the user sets them: the Steam and Game Center ids must match the ids made in Steamworks and App Store Connect, and the Play Console gives the Google Play ids.
